name: 16minds
description:
16-minds summons agents modeled on 16 distinct personality types — each with its own values, thinking patterns, and tone — to debate, review, or advise on any topic. Each personality is written directly into an independent prompt, so outputs carry visibly different voices instead of the averaged answer a single agent tends to produce.

Three commands cover the range:
  - /mind <type> — a single type's opinion
  - /pair <a> <b> — a two-type debate (open → rebut → reply / synthesize)
  - /minds — fan out to all 16 in parallel, then synthesize

Three modes (light / middle / heavy) trade depth for token cost.

The /minds synthesis follows a fixed 4-section rubric — score distribution, axes of disagreement, easily-overlooked perspectives, and landing-zone candidates with per-candidate "types likely to agree / fit / risk" — to keep 16-voice output structured rather than scattershot. The --save flag writes the full execution log to a file for use as article material or decision logs.

Built for decisions where a single averaged answer would lose the edges: idea generation, design judgment, code review, and life/career questions.
longDescription:
Ships **4 skills**, **16 agents** and **3 commands**.

- **Skills** (4): `voice-ask` (Use when the user presents an idea/plan/proposal and wants a specific 16-minds (MBTI) personality to ask probing questions…), `voice-decide` (Use when the user provides multiple options and wants a specific 16-minds (MBTI) personality to make the decision…), `voice-vote` (Use when the user wants all 16 personality types (16-minds plugin) to vote on a proposal — yes/no/abstain…), `voice-write` (Use when the user wants to write text in a specific 16-minds (MBTI) personality's voice — articles, blog…)
- **Agents** (16): `enfj` (ENFJ (主人公) — empathic leader who reads the room and steers toward shared growth), `enfp` (ENFP (運動家) — enthusiastic possibility-connector), `entj` (ENTJ (指揮官) — commanding, decisive, results-driven organizer), `entp` (ENTP (討論者) — contrarian, idea-generator, playful provocateur), `esfj` (ESFJ (領事官) — social-glue harmonizer, tradition-keeper, image-aware), `esfp` (ESFP (エンターテイナー) — spontaneous, people-warm, present-saturated), `estj` (ESTJ (幹部) — by-the-book executor, accountability-obsessed, traditionalist organizer), `estp` (ESTP (起業家) — action-first opportunist, calculated risk-taker, situationally adaptive), and 8 more
- **Commands** (3): `mind` (Get one personality type's opinion on a topic), `minds` (Get all 16 personality types' opinions on a topic, then synthesize), `pair` (Pair two personality types in a debate on a topic)

Installs with `claude plugin install 16minds@claude-community` from `yukurash/16minds-plugin`.
